caption: A pendulum swings in front of a wall lit by a lamp, and its shadow on the wall swings with it.

sa.check: A pendulum swings in front of a wall.
The pendulum's shadow on the wall swings with it.
The wall is lit by a lamp.

pc.expect: The shadow moves in step with the pendulum, in the same rhythm, and never leads it or moves on its own.
pc.fail: It swings out of time; or it leads the pendulum; or it swings while the pendulum hangs still.

pc.expect: The string's shadow stays joined to the shadow of the pivot and the bob's shadow to the string's.
pc.fail: The bob's shadow detaches from the string's; or the pivot's shadow moves; or the shadow splits.

pc.expect: The shadow falls on the wall on the side away from the lamp.
pc.fail: It falls on the lamp side; or on the ceiling; or it is missing with the lamp on.

pc.expect: The string stays taut and straight through the swing.
pc.fail: It goes slack at the ends; or bends mid-length; or stretches.
A second bob or shadow appears; or the bob vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the string passes through the bob.

pc.expect: The pendulum and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The bob changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.
